steps.title: Prepare Nuclei Suspension Buffer (NSB)
steps.instruction: Prepare the NSB based on the intended downstream application:

substeps.instruction: For drop-seq: 1x PBS, 0.01% BSA (ultra pure), 0.2U/ul RNAse inhibitor
For 10X Genomics: 1X PBS, 1% BSA (ultra pure), 0.2U/ul RNase inhibitor

steps.title: Homogenize Brain Tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize the brain tissue on ice.

substeps.instruction: Place ~250mg of brain tissue into a douncer with 10ml of ice-cold lysis buffer.
Dounce the tissue for 2 min while on ice.

steps.title: Set Up Sucrose Gradient
steps.instruction: Prepare the ultracentrifuge tube for gradient separation on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add 18ml of sucrose solution into a new 30ml clear ultracentrifuge tube.
Carefully layer the homogenized brain on top of the sucrose solution.
Weigh the ultracentrifuge tubes and adjust the weight using lysis buffer.

steps.title: Ultracentrifuge Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples using an SW28 rotor at 24,400 RPM (107,163.6 RCF) for 2.5 hours at 4°C.

steps.title: Recover and Filter Nuclei
steps.instruction: Isolate the nuclei pellet and remove debris.

substeps.instruction: Add 500μL of NSB to each pellet and incubate on ice for 10 min.
Filter the suspension through a Flowmi cell strainer (Bel-Art, H13680-0040).
Transfer the filtered suspension into one 2ml tube on ice.

steps.title: Quantify and Adjust Nuclei Concentration
steps.instruction: Count the nuclei and adjust the final concentration using NSB.

substeps.instruction: Stain 10μl of nuclei suspension with DAPI (1:5000) or 0.4% Trypan Blue to count.
Adjust the volume with NSB to 1000 nuclei/μl for 10X Genomics or 300 nuclei/μl for drop-seq.
